cards.text: Peter and John, two of Jesus' apostles, have just helped a man who was lame from birth get up and walk, and he went leaping into the temple courts while the crowd stared (Acts 3:1-11). Now Peter and John are speaking to the people. Then the priests, the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees, a Jewish group, come up to them.

cards.question: The priests, the guard captain and the Sadducees are greatly disturbed by Peter and John. What has them so upset?

answers.text: They proclaim the resurrection in Jesus
They break the Sabbath in the temple

cards.text: So they seize Peter and John, and because it's evening, they hold them in custody until the next day. That's like your boss texting you "We need to talk. Tomorrow." and then going to BED.

cards.question: Even with Peter and John in custody, many who heard the message believe, and the number of men grows to about ___.

cards.text: The next day, the rulers, elders and scribes assemble in Jerusalem with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, who is Annas's son-in-law (John 18:13), a man named John (not the apostle John), Alexander and many others from the high priest's family. So that "We need to talk. Tomorrow." meeting has the WHOLE leadership team in it.

cards.question: Peter and John are brought in before the leaders. What do the leaders ask them about the healing?

answers.text: By what power or name they did it
Why they healed on the Sabbath day
If the man was truly lame before

cards.text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, says that if they're being examined about a kind service to a man who was lame, he'll tell them how the man was healed. One night in custody, and he's not asking to go home, he's ready to EXPLAIN.

cards.question: Peter wants all the people of Israel to know how the man was healed. By whose name does the man stand there healed?
Peter softens it and tells the council they had no part in Jesus' death.

cards.text: Peter tells them straight: they crucified Jesus, but God raised Him from the dead. The resurrection is what had the priests and Sadducees so disturbed yesterday, and Peter just said it AGAIN, right in front of the council.
Then Peter borrows a picture from Psalm 118:22 and says this Jesus is the stone the builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.

cards.question: In Peter's picture of the stone, who are the builders who rejected it?

answers.text: The rulers and elders in that room

cards.question: Peter says salvation exists in no one else. There is no other ___ under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.

cards.text: The council sees how bold Peter and John are, and they realize these are unschooled, ordinary men. Friend, these two are talking straight to the high priest and the rulers, and I once lost an argument to the dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with.

cards.question: The council marvels, and they take note that Peter and John had been with ___.
With the healed man standing right there beside Peter and John, the council has nothing to say in response.

cards.text: So they send Peter and John out of the Sanhedrin, the council, and admit to each other that a remarkable miracle has happened through them, and they cannot deny it. I mean, what are they gonna say, the man's a STUNT DOUBLE?

cards.question: The council can't deny the miracle, but they want to keep the message from spreading. What's their plan?

answers.text: Warn them not to speak in this name
Run them out of Jerusalem for good
Hand them over to Pilate for trial

cards.text: They call Peter and John back in and command them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus. Peter and John reply, "Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God's sight to listen to you rather than God."

cards.question: Then Peter and John tell the council what they just cannot stop doing. What is it?

answers.text: Speaking about what they saw and heard
Healing everyone who asks them to
Traveling from one town to the next

cards.text: After further threats, the council lets them go, but friend, telling these two to stop talking is like telling my oven to quit being HOT.

cards.question: The council can't find a way to punish Peter and John, because all the people are ___ God for what happened.

cards.text: The man who was miraculously healed is over forty years old. He was lame from birth (Acts 3:2), so that's over forty YEARS of being lame, and now he's WALKING.
Once they're released, Peter and John go back to their own people and report everything the chief priests and elders said to them. You KNOW that group chat lit up.

cards.question: When the believers hear the report, they lift up their voices to God together.

cards.text: They pray, "Sovereign Lord," and say out loud that He made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them. Before they ask for a single thing, they start with WHO He is, and me, I'd have opened with my list.

Then they quote what God spoke by the Holy Spirit through David, Israel's king, in Psalm 2:1-2: "Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?" The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers gather together.

cards.question: In David's words, the kings and rulers gather together. Who are they gathering against?

answers.text: The Lord and His Anointed One
The temple and the holy city

cards.text: The believers say that in this very city, Herod, a ruler, and Pontius Pilate, governor of Judea (Luke 3:1), conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against God's holy servant Jesus, whom He anointed. So the Anointed One in David's psalm is Jesus, and the plotting happened right here in Jerusalem.

cards.question: Herod and Pilate plotted against Jesus. According to the believers' prayer, what did they end up carrying out?

answers.text: A warning given in a dream
Orders sent to them from Rome

cards.question: The believers pray, "And now, Lord, consider their threats," and then they ask Him for something. What is it?

cards.text: Peter and John just got threatened, and the believers ask for COMPLETE boldness as God stretches out His hand to heal and do signs and wonders through the name of Jesus. Somebody threatens me, I'm praying for a hiding spot, but these folks pray for a MEGAPHONE.

cards.question: After the believers pray, the place where they're meeting is ___.

cards.text: And they are all filled with the Holy Spirit, just like Peter was when he stood before the council.

cards.question: After their meeting place shakes, the believers are too afraid to keep speaking the word of God.
